# GGUF Switchboard

> Hardware-aware local model runtime supporting GGUF via llama.cpp and SafeTensors via vLLM.

## Overview

GGUF Switchboard exposes local models through one OpenAI-compatible API and dynamically manages model runtimes according to model format and hardware constraints.

## Key Concepts

- **One machine, many models, one API** — run multiple local AI models through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint
- **GGUF via llama.cpp** — quantized models for constrained VRAM, CPU/GPU offloading, broad hardware compatibility
- **SafeTensors via vLLM** — Hugging Face models for higher-throughput GPU inference, modern architectures
- **Automatic model switching** — request-driven single-slot switching with drain, rollback, and idle priority warm-up
- **Hardware-aware search** — `ggs models search` scores every quant against detected hardware

## Model Runtimes

- GGUF → llama.cpp
- SafeTensors → vLLM
- vLLM environment managed through uv

## CLI Commands

```bash
ggs serve                              # Start the server
ggs models search <query>              # Search GGUF/llama.cpp models
ggs models search vllm <query>         Search SafeTensors/vLLM models
ggs models pull <repo-id> --quant Q4_K_M  # Download and register a GGUF model
ggs models pull vllm <repo-id>         # Download and register a vLLM model
ggs models list                        # List models on disk
ggs status                             # Show service status
ggs logs                               # Show service logs
```

## API Endpoints

- `/v1/chat/completions` — OpenAI Chat Completions
- `/v1/completions` — OpenAI Text Completions
- `/v1/embeddings` — OpenAI Embeddings
- `/v1/responses` — OpenAI Responses API
- `/v1/messages` — Anthropic Messages API
- `/v1/models` — List configured models
- `/health` — Liveness probe
- `/metrics` — Prometheus metrics
- `/swagger-ui/` — Interactive API explorer

## Supported Clients

- OpenCode
- Cursor
- Cline
- Continue
- OpenAI SDK (Python, Node.js)
- Any OpenAI-compatible client
